verdict.rationale: Cursor documents a public Cloud Agents API that launches and manages agents, with a live OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, Bearer/Basic API-key auth, and published rate limits. It also offers official TypeScript and Python SDKs for calling its agent from code, plus Admin, Analytics and Origin APIs. Probes confirm the API host is live and key-gated and that the spec downloads. missing for 10: the Cloud Agents API is still public beta with webhooks not yet available in v1, and there is no independent community corroboration of real-world API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Cloud Agents API lets you programmatically launch and manage cloud agents that work on your repositories.
The `@cursor/sdk` package lets you call Cursor's agent from your own code.
the documented Cloud Agents API host is live and key-gated exactly as docs/api.md describes
